description.p: Tobari is a web browser with an assistant that runs on your own GPU. Prompts stay on your computer unless you add a cloud provider with your own key.

ul.li: Vertical tabs, workspaces and a command bar
An assistant that reads pages, PDFs and your open tabs, and asks before it clicks or types
Skills as plain folders, memory as plain Markdown files
Imports bookmarks and history from Chrome, Brave, Edge and Firefox
